solarCorrectionResolution.finalSentence: Sailors use the Sun to find local time, corrected to match the clock’s timekeeping.
solarCorrectionResolution.previousSentence: The Sun’s uneven timekeeping needs a correction.
solarCorrectionResolution.referenceReadingQualification: Corrected for known clock error; simultaneous readings and date/day branch resolved.
solarCorrectionResolution.why: Correction is attached directly to the Sun-derived reading, avoiding a detached technical digression. match the clock’s timekeeping means convert apparent solar time to mean solar time, not synchronize or reset the reference clock.
